# TidyBot ROS 2 driver source

The ITRI root Compose builds the ROS 2 driver from this MIT-licensed snapshot.
It contains the ROS package, Docker files and tests from
[tidybot_ros2_control](https://github.com/LesterLiou/tidybot_ros2_control/tree/eb0acb4062b82562c6b859af344790bc3a59c845).
The upstream simulation, training and arm model assets are outside this driver package.
